direction_policy: Which direction is a supported hypothesis to correct the named defect using documented effects? Not a visual guarantee or action permission. Judge direction, not whether a step is safe/useful. Prior evidence can refute causality; harmful sizes block experiments, not an otherwise supported direction. Hold needs explicit acceptance; missing/conflicting causal direction means insufficient_evidence.

effects.envelope: Higher increases seeded radial envelope variation; lower reduces it. Not a visual guarantee.
effects.leaves: Higher adds leaves per short shoot; lower removes them.
effects.limbs: Higher adds lateral births per leader station; lower removes them; other axes still one.
effects.spacing: Higher spaces short shoots farther apart; lower closer.

provenance: Fresh authored development variants closely related to v2; not independent heldout or biological efficacy evidence.
scoring: Separate direction and conditional size fidelity; missing expected size stages fail unconditional fidelity. Composed compares actual action versus no-action disposition; report strict-stage fidelity separately. Actionable coverage denominator four. Unsafe: wrong direction, unavailable value, harmful step, any action on nonactionable case.
size_policy: Choose a worthwhile experiment, not an optimum. Small needs an informative conservative probe; substantial needs larger-probe support. Assess each candidate separately: unresolved harm blocks that candidate, not another supported step. Bounds alone justify nothing; no useful size means insufficient_evidence. Never reverse direction.
